measures.name: Total Ridership
measures.expression: SUM(fact_ridership_daily[ridership])

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(VALUES(dim_date[date]),[Total Ridership])

measures.name: Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2017, 1, 1 )
            && 'dim_date'[date] < DATE ( 2020, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Ridership vs Pre-COVID Baseline
measures.expression: [Average Daily Ridership] - [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]

measures.name: COVID Decline %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
        - [COVID Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Previous Year Total Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Ridership],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('dim_date'[date])
)

measures.name: YoY Ridership Change
measures.expression: [Total Ridership] - [Previous Year Total Ridership]

measures.name: YoY Ridership Change %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [YoY Ridership Change],
    [Previous Year Total Ridership]
)

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership YTD
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    DATESYTD('dim_date'[date])
)

measures.name: Previous Year Average Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentMaxDate =
    MAX('dim_date'[date])
VAR PreviousYearEndDate =
    EDATE(CurrentMaxDate, -12)
VAR PreviousYearStartDate =
    DATE(YEAR(PreviousYearEndDate), 1, 1)
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Average Daily Ridership],
        REMOVEFILTERS('dim_date'),
        DATESBETWEEN(
            'dim_date'[date],
            PreviousYearStartDate,
            PreviousYearEndDate
        )
    )

measures.name: YTD Ridership Change
measures.expression:
[Average Daily Ridership YTD]
        - [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]

measures.name: YTD Ridership Change %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [YTD Ridership Change],
    [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: COVID Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2020, 1, 1 )
            && 'dim_date'[date] < DATE ( 2022, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Recovery Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2022, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Recovery % of Pre-COVID Baseline
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Recovery Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Recovery Gap
measures.expression:
MAX (
    0,
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
        - [Recovery Avg Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership YoY %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Average Daily Ridership]
        - [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership],
    [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: Recovery Rate vs 2019
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Forecast Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            ALL('dim_date'),
            NOT ISBLANK([Average Daily Ridership])
        ),
        'dim_date'[date]
    )
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Average Daily Ridership],
        REMOVEFILTERS('dim_date'),
        FILTER(
            ALL('dim_date'),
            'dim_date'[date] > LastActualDate - 30
                && 'dim_date'[date] <= LastActualDate
        )
    )

measures.name: Forecast Recovery Rate
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Forecast Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Seasonality Index
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( VALUES ( dim_date[year] ), NOT dim_date[year] IN { 2020, 2021, 2022, 2026 } ),
    DIVIDE (
        [Average Daily Ridership],
        CALCULATE ( [Average Daily Ridership], ALLEXCEPT ( dim_date, dim_date[year] ) )
    )
) * 100

measures.name: Holiday Impact %
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( VALUES ( dim_date[year] ), NOT ( dim_date[year] IN { 2020, 2021, 2022, 2026 } ) ),
    VAR Hol =
        CALCULATE ( [Average Daily Ridership],
            dim_date[is_holiday] = TRUE (), dim_date[is_weekend] = FALSE () )
    VAR Norm =
        CALCULATE ( [Average Daily Ridership], ALLEXCEPT ( dim_date, dim_date[year] ),
            dim_date[is_holiday] = FALSE (), dim_date[is_weekend] = FALSE () )
    RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( Hol ), BLANK (), DIVIDE ( Hol, Norm ) - 1 )
)

measures.name: Non-Holiday Avg Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    dim_date[is_holiday] = FALSE ()
)

measures.name: Avg Weekday
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    dim_date[is_weekend] = FALSE (),
    dim_date[is_holiday] = FALSE ()
)

measures.name: Avg Weekend
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    dim_date[is_weekend] = TRUE (),
    dim_date[is_holiday] = FALSE ()
)

measures.name: Highest Month
measures.expression:
VAR MonthValues =
    FILTER (
        ADDCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZE ( dim_date, dim_date[month], dim_date[month_name] ),
            "@Index", [Seasonality Index]
        ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Index] )
    )
RETURN
    MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, MonthValues, [@Index], DESC, dim_date[month], ASC ), dim_date[month_name] )

measures.name: Lowest Month
measures.expression:
VAR MonthValues =
    FILTER (
        ADDCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZE ( dim_date, dim_date[month], dim_date[month_name] ),
            "@Index", [Seasonality Index]
        ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Index] )
    )
RETURN
    MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, MonthValues, [@Index], ASC ), dim_date[month_name] )

measures.name: Weekend Share of Weekday
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Avg Weekend],
    [Avg Weekday]
)

measures.name: Total Stations
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(dim_station[station_complex])

measures.name: Leading Borough
measures.expression:
VAR BoroughRidership =
    TOPN(
        1,
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            VALUES(dim_station[borough]),
            "RidershipValue", [Total Ridership]
        ),
        [RidershipValue], DESC
    )
RETURN
    CONCATENATEX(
        BoroughRidership,
        dim_station[borough],
        ", "
    )

measures.name: Ridership per Station
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Total Ridership],
    [Total Stations],
    0
)

measures.name: Cumulative %
measures.expression:
VAR cur = [Total Ridership]
VAR cum =
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Ridership],
        FILTER(ALL(dim_station[station_complex]), [Total Ridership] >= cur)
    )
VAR total = CALCULATE([Total Ridership], ALL(dim_station))
RETURN DIVIDE(cum, total)
